name: hex_flight
for: hexer hex (Motion::Shot 5/TPS, GuardBreak; road fight shot(7.5, true, Look::Hex) homes on the lane)
notes: A cursed violet wisp in the hexer's staff-flame colours: a drawn flame-teardrop head with two sickly yellow-green eyes (they blink once a loop), noses up/down 3 px as if sniffing, and a hooked tendril tail that curls into loops behind it, shedding pale motes. Anchor = the head (pivot). 10 fps, 12 frames. Game: let the clip's own bob ride on top of the lane-homing path.
